messages:
Alex R: Quick note — ran the initial bring-up for the new 14B int8 variant on the staging rigs. Need a short recommendation for GTN: keep as premium model, or fold into default routing?

Priya K: TL;DR: quality up vs 13B-int4, cost ~+28% per token, latency ~+15% p50. Worth it for high-value flows.

Ben L: Numbers?

Alex R: From batch runs (seq=512, conv workload):
```
model         | p50 latency | p95 latency | tokens/sec | cost/1M tokens (proxy)
13B-int4      | 120ms       | 340ms       | 2200       | $6.2
14B-int8      | 138ms       | 390ms       | 1900       | $8.0
7B-int4       | 85ms        | 240ms       | 3100       | $3.1
```
Quality (eval-suite A - safety+qa+humane):
- 14B-int8: +3.5 pts overall vs 13B-int4 (notable on code reasoning & long-context QA)
- 13B-int4: strong baseline, best cost/quality sweet spot for mid-tier flows
- 7B-int4: good latency but regressions on long-context coherence

Maya S: eval-bot summary pls?

eval-bot: Patch results for thread 1790456123:
- Win-rate (14B-int8 vs 13B-int4): 62% on product QA suite
- Codebench: 14B-int8 +9% exact match on small function generation tests
- Safety filter false positives: neutral
- Tokenization perf similar across models
(report: /internal/evals/1790456123)

Sam T: Good detail. GTN asks: which model to recommend as default for new sign-ups vs paid customers?

Ben L: My rec: default routing = 13B-int4 (cost-efficient, stable).
- Offer 14B-int8 as "High-accuracy tier" in console and API param `model: redwood-14b-int8`.
- For Dedicated customers who commit capacity, include 14B-int8 in reserved SKU.

Priya K: Also recommend policy-based auto-fallbacks: primary route -> 14B-int8 for traffic tagged `high_value=true`; else 13B-int4. If p95 latency > 500ms -> fall back to 13B-int4.

Maya S: For GTN messaging: emphasize "+3.5 pts overall accuracy, ideal for complex reasoning and code generation" and call out unit economics: "~28% higher per-token cost".

Jorge: Ops note — memory footprint of 14B-int8 requires slightly larger instance classes (adds 1 GPU slot per pool), so Dedicated pricing calc needed.

Alex R: Rollout plan idea: 1) Internal canary (5% prod traffic) + eval harness monitoring; 2) A/B experiment on select customers; 3) Full GA as paid option. Add automatic quality regression alerts tied to eval-set.

Priya K: Also run a quant-sensitivity pass: try 14B with mixed int8-int4 paths (hot-kv int8, weights int4) to see if we recoup cost while preserving quality. If that gets within 10% cost of 13B-int4 with <1pt quality drop, consider making it default.

Sam T: Actionable asks for product/GTN doc: one-paragraph recommendation + 3 bullets (when to use 14B-int8, when to use 13B-int4, routing policy). Can someone draft?

Maya S: I'll draft. Short version: "Recommend 13B-int4 as default for most customers due to best cost/latency balance. Offer 14B-int8 as premium accuracy option for high-value flows and code/long-context workloads. Use policy-based routing with latency fallback and a staged canary rollout." :thumbsup:

Ben L: Tests to run before canary: perf at seq=1024, multitenant isolation run, and cold-start mem pressure.

Alex R: Good. I'll schedule the seq=1024 bench and the mixed-quant experiment this week.

Jorge: I'll update Dedicated SKU spreadsheet with memory/instance delta and tentative pricing impact.

Sam T: Thanks — please ping once Maya has the GTN blurb. We want this in the next partner newsletter if numbers hold.

Maya S: Will do. Draft ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya K: One more note: add canary guardrails to block if safety eval drops >1pt or latency p95 increases >40%.

Alex R: Agreed. Closing loop once results in `/internal/evals/1790456123` are final.
